title: Paris rock 'n' roll show and a stop in Hawaii
summary: In Paris he played with a big show of old-time American musicians; in Hawaii he drank with a manager's mother.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Worked over in Paris month or two...was with a big rock 'n' roll show over there. Had a bunch o' strange people I never saw before. They was all a-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-oll'-timers, played music back like in that book you got.
The Story Of The Blues by Paul Oliver. That book?
Yeah. I played with a bunch o' them I had never seen before.

Yeah, yeah. They's from over here in the states ...and wind up playin' over there for 'bout a coupla months with that big show, an' then we come on back home again. Then we took off an' went to Hawaii. Went over in Hawaii an' played over there. I'd never been over there except when I went to Australia. I'd a wasn't over there for just a few hours when we's on our way to Australia. I never left the airport. Just me and the manager's mother...she was a gas. She was in a wheelchair. She had a bottle o' Grandad hidden up under her shawl an' uh, the bar was upstairs in Hawaii so we couldn't get upstairs so I told her I was gonna bring her a drink down.

She says, "I don't need no drink. I got my drinks right here in my...in my wagon in here."

So I said, "Well, you excuse me. I'll go up here and have me a few drinks an' I be back, an' we struck it off real good. Then we went to the hotel and went to sleep...got up ..took a bath. Then we went uptown...all over Ha...huh...I mean...we went all over Hawaii,
lookin' for the different nightclubs...'cause it was in...it was in the daytime an' we didn't get a chance to see too much. And then we moved out from there...come back to California again.
